description: Score a session via rule-based engine + Groq refinement. Two modes: pass session_id to load metrics from DB and persist the score; OR pass metrics inline for ad-hoc grading. Set fanout=true to immediately fire the offline-conversion signal back to the originating ad network using the account's stored creds.

base_value.description: Base conversion value for A+/A grades. Default 100.

fanout.description: If true, fan the grade out to the originating ad network immediately.

persist.description: Default true. Set false to grade without writing dr_ai_scores.

name: dr_grade
